metric_name_raw: power reduction relative to average base load
metric_definition: Percent reduction in measured GPU-cluster power relative to average base load during the utility peak event.
denominator_raw: average base load during the peak-demand period
baseline_description: average cluster base load during the peak-demand period
short_excerpt_le_25_words: Each event required the cluster to reduce power by 25% with respect to the average base load.
notes: Eligible as a verified singleton contextual value; fewer than five independent studies prohibit a central summary.
